g.title: J_OBC_RF
g.text: OBC board J2 at (+41.0, -33.5), below RF J1: PD5, PD6, PE3, PE4, PA0, PC0, PC1; inputs TONE_OK PC9, XPDR_KEY PG12, PTT_EXCITER PC7 (capture), RX_CD PG0, RX_FAULT PF13, each 10 k series and 100 k pull-down (SQSO-ICX-001 B 3.2)

g.title: W4A
g.text: 3.3 V logic both ends (RF side 3.1 V CMOS, 1 k series on the readbacks). Monitors 0-2.5 V into ADC1. TX_PWR_SEL low 0.5 W, high 1 W. XPDR_EN: 100 Hz heartbeat, 100 k pull-down on the RF board. RX_CD, RX_FAULT active high, 100 k pull-downs (not fault when unpowered). Flat and vertical in the +X wall gap at y -28.5 to -38.5, no fold; the (+X, -Y) bundle moves to y -17 to -27

g.title: J_EPS_RF
g.text: EPS board: SW2 RADIO, SW3 PA outputs

g.title: W4B
g.text: RADIO rail 3.3 V: 31 mA typ, 38 mA worst receiving, +51 mA while keyed (exciter). PA rail 5 V: 0.35 A at 0.5 W RF, 0.47 A at 1 W, two contacts. Twisted pairs: 3 with 2, 4 with 5, 1 with 6 (no loop field at magnetometer A2); RF J2 at (-26, -44)
